description: Develops categories with families and comprehension from dependent set families, reindexing, and context extension via pullback. Dependent sums and products illustrate adjoints to substitution; the lecture explains Beck–Chevalley stability and why strict substitution and definitional equality require more than arbitrary isomorphic pullbacks.
